prompt: 2,4-pentanedione (acac) has pKa ~9. Why is it dramatically more acidic than acetone (pKa ~20)?

options.label: Deprotonation gives an enolate stabilized by TWO flanking carbonyls.
The sp² C is inductively acidic.

explanation: 1,3-dicarbonyls have α-H between two C=O groups; the enolate is doubly resonance-stabilized.
